# Champion

- Full Name (Company) - @githubhandle

*Every initiative must have a champion, to even be proposed - this is the primary
point person for making sure the inititive stays on track, coordinating
progress, etc.*

*Champions may be changed, but if an initiative ever loses a champion, it will
immediately be closed.*

# Implementation Leads

- Full Name (Company) - @githubhandle

*These are the people who have pledged to help contribute development or
implementation time.  There can be multiple, but for easier cross-company
coordination, there should be at most one per company.*

*An initiative does not require any Implementation Leads when proposed; however,
unless it is an initiative that does not require out-of-meeting implementation
(like an initiative to "Gather Concensus on X"), initiatives that cannot get any
to pledge to be an Implementation Lead will eventually be closed.*

*Note that while the "assignee" field may change "frequently", as the next person
for whom action is required by changes, the Implementation Leads should be
relatively static.*
